reconciliation_matrix.title: Goal B R1 Claim Revocation and Machine-to-Human Reconciliation Matrix

revocations.R1_TREND_LEAKAGE: REVOKED: Goal B R1 run.py (lines 136-142) assigned trend alignment using path24h.before12h.Last_MFE_R vs Last_MAE_R, which leaks the post-entry [0, 12h) in-trade price path. All R1 claims asserting predictive trend regimes are WITHDRAWN.
revocations.R1_VOLATILITY_SUBSTITUTION: REVOKED: Goal B R1 run.py (lines 145-146) binned volatility via risk_bps > 300 instead of the predeclared expanding prior-only 90d completed 1h ATR14 percentile. All R1 claims asserting high/low volatility regime performance are WITHDRAWN.
revocations.R1_FUNDING_LEAKAGE: REVOKED: Goal B R1 run.py (lines 149-154) extracted funding state from e0['funding_settlements'][0], which is the first settlement settling AFTER trade entry. All R1 claims asserting positive/negative funding regime advantages are WITHDRAWN.
revocations.R1_W2_YEAR_MISSTATEMENT: RECONCILED: Goal B R1 human report Table 4 misstated W2 annual trade counts as 2021: 14, 2022: 17, 2023: 24. Verified primary Exit R1 machine records are 2021: 10, 2022: 21, 2023: 24 (total 55). The machine truth is strictly preserved.
revocations.R1_SKIPPED_SIGNALS_MISSTATEMENT: RECONCILED: Goal B R1 human report Table 3 stated 0 skipped signals for E0, masking that E0 single-position account simulation also blocked candidate signals arriving during its 12h hold and cooldown.
revocations.R1_SLIPPAGE_VECTOR_DIFF: RECONCILED: In R1 Commit 1 slippage was temporarily set to 16/8 bp before being corrected in Commit 2 to 12/6 bp to match frozen STRESS44 (24 fee + 8 spread + 12 slip = 44 bp) and BASE22 (12 fee + 4 spread + 6 slip = 22 bp). STRESS44 / BASE22 are strictly frozen.
revocations.NO_STRATEGY_SEARCH: ATTESTED: Post-hoc causal repair is an observational diagnostic addendum only. Zero new entry rules, exit policies, parameter sweeps, or conditional switching variants are tested or promoted.

w2_annual_trade_counts.root_cause: Human copy-paste transposition in R1 report markdown table. Underlying machine ledger always contained 10 (2021) and 21 (2022).

account_skipped_signals.metric: Opportunity cost simulation blocked / skipped signal counts
account_skipped_signals.root_cause: Human table set E0 to 0 because E0 was the reference baseline, masking that E0 also blocked burst signals arriving within its 12h hold. Critically, ZERO additional signals were missed in (12h, 24h) extended windows.

cost_model_parameters.metric: BASE22 and STRESS44 round-trip friction vectors
cost_model_parameters.root_cause: Temporary slippage discrepancy in R1 Commit 1 was corrected in Commit 2. All R2 analyses strictly use frozen BASE22 and STRESS44.
